defs.def: coins that are made of silver or a metal that looks like silver 银币（银或似银金属制成的硬币）

ex.s: So while some of the world's first coins were made from a naturally occurring hybrid of gold and silver called electrum, objects other than coins have served as currency, including beads, ivory, livestock, and cowrie shells.
ex.t: 因此,虽然世界上最早的一些硬币是用一种自然形成的金银混合铸造的,称为electrum,但硬币以外的物品作为货币,包括珠子,象牙,牲畜,和牛力壳.

defs.def: dishes, decorative objects, etc. that are made of silver 银器
a shiny greyish-white colour 银色；银白色；银灰色
她在去年的锦标赛上获得银牌。
to cover the surface of sth with a thin layer of silver or sth that looks like silver 给 … 镀（或包）银；给 … 镀（或包）似银的物质
to make sth become bright like silver 使具有银色光泽；使变成银色
